body:
This implementation offers:
 - a full helper to modify the parameters before sending the request
 - all the other search function (searchOnce, searchForFacetValues)
 - compatibility with async code (no oops effect)

*warning*: This also contains a modification of the slider to be extra sure that we'll never update the state unnecessarily https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/8b7a6eb60fe879c0fa9841931dffbe2d91d1b24b

Fixes #1924 

 - [Deployed version with 2sec lag of all search requests](http://flashy-art.surge.sh/): test the async
 - [Nominal version](http://bite-sized-birth.surge.sh/): just a simple search function, this also serve to test the perf of the search function mechanics
 - [without any search function implementation](http://busy-snail.surge.sh/): let you test the slider modification by itself
